about_the_game:
Are you ready to find 500 adorable cats lost in the dark and fun world of Halloween? Explore 5 unique maps filled with spooky but playful Halloween-themed hand-drawn scenes. Discover cats hiding in these scenes and color each one by numbers to brighten this mysterious night!

Each map offers a detailed, dark, and mystical Halloween atmosphere. Can you find the cats hidden in this scary but fun world?

🎨 After finding them, color each scene only by numbers. Experience this mysterious night with the relaxing power of colors and Halloween vibes!

✨ Features:

🎃 5 unique Halloween maps

🐱 500 hidden cats in total

🎨 Paint-by-numbers system

🧘‍♀️ Relaxed gameplay without time pressure

🎧 Special themed Halloween radio broadcast

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play online duo with a friend
